messages:
rafa: Planning a targeted unpin tonight 21:30 UTC: runtime 2.14 -> 2.17 for hosted canary. Goal: small perf gains for shortseq, but perf lab flagged a longseq tail in ap-south. Change window 21:30-00:30 UTC. Telemetry: https://telemetry.internal/case/3812-longseq-tail
meena: +1 but recommend regional split: ap-south and eu-central on a conservative cohort. We'll exclude region=ap-south from full ramp until +60m. Also keep model-tag=longseq pinned to 2.14 by routing rule.
ops-sre: I'll own watch and rollback. Rollback triggers: sustained p99 > baseline*1.4 for 8m OR user_error_rate delta > 0.6% for 5m. On trigger deploybot will pin runtime=2.14 for affected region/cohort and broadcast to #incidents.
kyle: Staged plan suggestion: 21:30 -> 4% global (region slice: us first) 15m smoke -> 20% limited regions 25m -> 60% non-ap-south at +50m -> 100% except ap-south if green. Set canary flag `feature.unpin_3812`.
rafa: I'll prep release notes and an internal post. Draft: https://notes.internal/rel-3812345678. Add SDK compatibility blurb for clients that rely on the old KV retention semantics.
meena: SDK impact: SDK 3.x clients doing proactive KV hints may observe higher miss ratios; propose server honor header `X-RW-KV-LEGACY: 1` to preserve prior behavior for tagged tenants. We'll document this and add sample curl.
support-bot: tagging @support; prepared canned response template and status page stub. Include link to traces and the rollback policy.
ops-sre: Runbook (abridged):
```
# unpin rollback
monitor windows: 0-90m
if p99_now >= p99_baseline * 1.4 for 8m OR user_err_rate_delta >= 0.006 for 5m:
  deploybot pin runtime=2.14 region=${affected_region} cohort=${cohort}
  post "UNPIN ROLLBACK" to #incidents with p99 graphs + top traces
  page eng-runtime oncall
  enable debug kvcache for cohort and collect top-50 traces
  if rollback occurs: open postmortem doc template and assign leads
```
rafa: Deploybot job created by @rafa: deploy-3812345678-01. To abort: `/deploy cancel deploy-3812345678-01`. Job metadata includes staged steps, rollback gates, and telemetry flags.
kyle: Ops checklist: enable `trace.kvcache_canary`, set `metrics.unpin_3812`, bump trace retention to 3h for cohort, and add header `X-RW-COHORT: unpin-3812` for easy slicing.
meena: QA: I'll run longseq regressions (quant and fp16 workloads) against the canary path. Testset: /qa/3812/longseq. I'll post smoke results after the 15m step.
rafa: Note for product: if rollback happens and customer impact is >10 tenants, we'll trigger a customer-facing status update. Tagging @product and @support.
ops-sre: I'll post first-stage status ~21:50 UTC. Everyone ack below if you are monitoring or assigned.
rafa: ack
kyle: ack
meena: ack
